Cards.Name: Death Chain
Cards.Description: Each enemy killed within 2 seconds increases Attack Damage by 4%, stacking up to 15 times. The stack resets when no enemy is killed for 2 seconds.

Cards.Name: Bullet Storm
Cards.Description: Every 8 attacks automatically fires a burst of 5 additional projectiles at nearby enemies.

Cards.Name: Execution Protocol
Cards.Description: Attacks against enemies below 15% HP have a chance to instantly execute them. Boss and Special enemies require them to be below 8% HP.

Cards.Name: Overkill
Cards.Description: Excess damage from killing an enemy is transferred to the nearest enemy, up to 300% of the original attack damage.

Cards.Name: Vampiric Frenzy
Cards.Description: Every 10% HP recovered through Life Steal increases Attack Speed by 3% for 5 seconds, stacking up to 10 times.

Cards.Name: Guardian Instinct
Cards.Description: When HP falls below 30%, gain a shield equal to 20% of max HP and increase Evasion by 15% for 6 seconds. Cooldown: 30 seconds.

Cards.Name: Critical Cascade
Cards.Description: Every Critical Hit has a 25% chance to trigger another projectile toward the nearest enemy. This projectile can also critically strike.

Cards.Name: War Machine
Cards.Description: When attacking continuously without stopping for 5 seconds, gain 10% Attack Damage, 10% Attack Speed and 10% Critical Chance. The bonuses reset after 3 seconds without attacking.

Cards.Name: Apocalypse Engine
Cards.Description: Every 50 enemies killed, increases Attack Damage by 1%, Attack Speed by 0.5% and Critical Damage by 2% for the current battle.

Cards.Name: Infinite Arsenal
Cards.Description: Every 12th attack fires a special projectile that pierces all enemies, bounces 3 times and has a 100% Critical Chance.

Cards.Name: Soul Harvester
Cards.Description: Every enemy killed grants a Soul. Each Soul increases Damage by 0.5%. Every 100 Souls, increases the maximum Soul stack by 50.

Cards.Name: Death Reversal
Cards.Description: The first time you would die, rewind your HP and position to 5 seconds earlier, restore 50% HP and reset enemy projectiles around you. Can trigger once per wave.

Cards.Name: Void Overlord
Cards.Description: Every 100 seconds, enter Void Overlord state for 15 seconds. During this state, all attacks pierce enemies, projectiles deal 100% bonus damage and enemies cannot recover HP.
